title: Average of Levels in Binary Tree
statement: Return the average value of the nodes on each level, from top to bottom. Answers within 1e-5 are accepted.
reference_solution:
def averageOfLevels(root):
    out = []
    level = [root] if root else []
    while level:
        out.append(sum(n.val for n in level) / len(level))
        level = [c for n in level for c in (n.left, n.right) if c]
    return out

hints.1_question: For each level you need the sum and the number of nodes.
hints.2_nudge: Walk level by level. Average = sum of the level's values / number of nodes in the level.
hints.3_big_hint: out.append(sum(n.val for n in level) / len(level)). Use true division.
